scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:ui && npm run install:admin
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:ui: cd 15market && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd 15market-admin && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,UI" -c "magenta,green,cyan" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:ui"
scripts.render:build: npm run render:install && npm run build
